title: Forced context pressure: real compaction, not truncation
objective: Produce two arithmetic results through the cluster, using the flow_sum tool for each, so the management sessions grow past a deliberately low compaction threshold.

initial_transactions.objective: Use the flow_sum tool on [2, 3] and submit the resulting number.
acceptance_criteria: The submitted result contains the number 5

initial_transactions.objective: Use the flow_sum tool on [15, 40] and submit the resulting number.
acceptance_criteria: The submitted result contains the number 55
At least one turn reports a real compaction with shadowed tokens
An accepted transaction leaves a durable summary
